svg.title: Which LinuxONE 5 fits
svg.desc: The three LinuxONE 5 models, all available now: LinuxONE 5 Express, a right-sized entry that is built to scale; LinuxONE Rockhopper 5, to consolidate thousands of cores in a single rack; LinuxONE Emperor 5, for the largest and most security-sensitive work.
